license: Official brand artwork from the TTArtisan website (Shenzhen Mingjiang Optical Technology Co., Ltd.), extracted as vector from an official user-manual PDF; no copyright licence is stated by the owner (not a formal press/brand kit). Public-domain status is by analogy only: a different TTArtisan lockup (stacked TT symbol over a mixed-case "TTArtisan" wordmark, 1566x1498 raster) is tagged {{PD-logo}} / PD-textlogo (below threshold of originality) + {{Trademarked}} on Wikimedia Commons: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:TTArtisanlogo-blk@4x.png. trademark: Shenzhen Mingjiang Optical Technology Co., Ltd. (深圳市铭匠光学科技有限公司, brand TTArtisan / 铭匠光学)
notes: Horizontal all-caps TTARTISAN wordmark (rounded monoline letters), identical to the header logo PNG on ttartisan.com (/static/upload/image/20241224/1735025319693036.png) and ttartisan.store. Extracted as vector (not traced): the PDF cover draws the wordmark as 9 filled outline paths (one per letter, colour #2c292a), the same 9-shape construction appears on the covers of the other APS-C/AF manuals, the viewfinder, dot-sight, M01 flash and J01 trigger manuals. Exported the page with PyMuPDF get_svg_image, baked each path matrix(1,0,0,-1,tx,ty) into absolute coordinates with svgpath, translated to origin and scaled x10, rounded to 0.01. One merged path, 12 subpaths (9 letters + counters of both As and the R); counters are already cut by opposite path direction, evenodd set for robustness (no overlapping subpaths, renders identically with nonzero). No background, (R) mark, tagline or symbol in the artwork. Mixed-case brand name TTArtisan is the display name; the logo itself is set in capitals.
